I've attached a small usage snapshot and a rough traffic curve so you can see our burst patterns. We'd like a simple pricing proposal that includes an ops guardrail (canary + rollback) and a migration path to a Dedicated pool if the pilot succeeds.

Hi Samantha — thanks for the snapshot, that helps. Quick first-pass answers below; we'll put a short, tailored commercial sketch together by EOD tomorrow once Kim and Connor weigh in.

Quantization: for a 7B decoder at the profile you described we typically recommend trying 4-bit per-channel quant first (FP4 / PTQ), then a model-aware 6-bit dynamic if you need conservative quality. Most customers see ~1.6-2.2x token-cost reduction with 4-bit and imperceptible quality regression on our evals for conversational tasks.

Batching: with your median prompt length and average response, a small adaptive batcher with a 40–60ms batching window plus a max-batch cap tuned to p50 SLAs tends to hit the sweet spot. That gets you the majority of batching wins while keeping p50 < 200ms. If you need p99 tail control, we layer a hot-path replicate (low-latency instances) for critical routes.

Commercial approach for 3-month pilot (ballpark):
- Credit-based pilot: $30k of Redwood credits applied to usage; we provide baseline tuning and two quantization profiles in scope + 1 week of runbook handover.
- Timeboxed flat fee: $18k professional services + $15k usage cap (use this if you want guaranteed ops time).
- Short commit: 3-month min commit $60k (discount applied, unlocks 20% off Optimize Toolkit per-token rates and access to cache pooling).

Attachments and next steps: Kim, Connor — can you review the technical guardrails (canary/rollback + SLA controls) and confirm ops hours included for the credit option? Samantha — if you can confirm the pilot cadence (start window: late Feb / early Mar) and whether the billing contact prefers credits or invoice, we'll finalize the proposal.

Thanks — Mateo

Hi Samantha / team — putting a concise pilot plan below so Carlos has what he needs for procurement. Mateo / Connor — please review and flag edits.

1) Pilot scope (3 months, start week of 2028-03-04)- Included: Optimize Toolkit (batching + KV cache), two quant profiles (4-bit PTQ default + 6-bit fallback), canary plan for traffic split, and weekly tuning syncs for first 4 weeks.- Ops: up to 12 hours of remediation/rollbacks included during pilot (handled by Redwood on-call). Additional hours billed at standard PSR rate.

2) Quality guardrails- Regression threshold: auto-rollback if model-level quality drop >1.0% on designated prompt set OR if p99 latency increases >30% vs baseline. Telemetry hooks and a short eval collection set will be instrumented prior to rollout.

3) Commercials (credit-based, preferred)- Redwood will issue $30,000 in pilot credits applied to Phi AI account covering both usage and included ops hours.- Usage beyond credits: invoiced monthly at list Optimize per-token rates (discounts unlock with committed spend).- Trigger: credits apply until exhausted OR 14 days after pilot end date — whichever comes first; we will notify Phi AI 7 days before credits expire.

4) On-ramp to Dedicated (optional)- If Phi elects Dedicated after pilot, credits convert to a discount against first-month commit up to 50% of unused credits.

Attachments: redwood-term-sheet-v2.pdf (term summary + SOW stub)
